summary: A messy CSV of error codes has spaces, lower case, empty cells and a duplicate. You load it with pandas, look at it, clean whole columns with strip, lower and upper, and print three clean rows.
goal: Load a CSV of error codes, clean it and print three clean rows.

items.text: Answer the two warm-up questions from memory, then guess the hook
Step 1: save the CSV, run uv add pandas and print shape, columns, head and isna().sum()
Step 2: clean code with upper() only, predict what happens to ' e102 ', then check
Step 3: ask for the column Title and read the KeyError, then read the FileNotFoundError
Step 4: print the high-severity rows (code and title) and the first three clean rows
Play the Table Detective game to the end and see your score
